note: Distribution size budgets. Each maximum is capped at 110% of the measured baseline, rounded up to the next KiB (see scripts/validate-release.ts). Updating a baseline requires refreshing measuredVersion and the rationale.

artifacts.rationale: Compressed `npm pack` tarball. Dominated by the bundled offline checker payload under dist/checker; 110% headroom absorbs declaration and dependency drift before a deliberate baseline bump is required.
Unpacked install size reported by `npm pack --dry-run`. The self-contained TypeScript checker inputs are the largest contributor; the budget guards against unbounded growth of dist/checker.
